camera_metadata.front_convention: official in_frustum keeps corners with camera-space z > 0.2
camera_metadata.intrinsics: project benchmark convention: JSON fov is vertical FOV; derive K, FoVx and FoVy from width/height/focal
camera_metadata.official_matrix_convention: world_view_transform = inverse(converted camera_to_world).T; projection_matrix matches CityGaussian utils.graphics_utils.getProjectionMatrix(...).T; full_proj_transform = world_view_transform @ projection_matrix for row-vector homogeneous corners
camera_metadata.project_conversion: flip camera Y/Z axes and multiply translation by scale_ratio
camera_metadata.selection_policy: np.linspace over [0, 1439] with sample_count=12, rounded to nearest integer, deduplicated, and sorted; includes first and final frames.

provenance.oracle_method: Official in_frustum executed on CPU with independently constructed official-compatible MAD cell bounds and camera matrices. Runtime scene visibility code is not imported or used.
